original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹琼莱州乌罗尔县SPLM初选因骚乱推迟
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹琼莱州乌罗尔县举行的苏丹人民解放运动（SPLM）初选投票因候选人支持者之间爆发骚乱而推迟。据称，投票过程中巴尔纳巴·马里亚尔博士得票领先，其两名竞争对手的支持者随后进入投票站干扰投票。负责监督投票的SPLM代表团已于周五离开该县，目前尚不清楚骚乱的具体起因。

location.raw_text: Uror County, Jonglei State, South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹琼莱州乌罗尔县SPLM初选投票因骚乱推迟
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The SPLM primary elections in Uror County ... have been postponed after riots erupted between supporters of Dr. Barnaba Marial Benjamin and those of his two rivals during voting on Friday.

key_facts.fact: 负责监督投票的SPLM代表团于周五离开该县
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the SPLM delegation overseeing the voting process left the county on Friday following the unrest

key_facts.fact: 据称竞争对手支持者进入投票站干扰投票
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the witness alleged that supporters of the rival candidates then entered the polling station and interfered with the remaining voting

key_facts.fact: 马里亚尔称其他候选人及其支持者在发现投票趋势后中断了投票进程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said that the other candidates and their supporters interrupted the process after noticing the voting trend.

uncertainties: 骚乱具体起因尚未完全明确
另一名候选人Wany Lam Tuor和Tang Chatim未立即回应置评请求
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
